subject: pubmatic

correct_transition_examples.relevant_characteristic: Confirmed LNF where implemented Tab order moves from the Log In button to the visually adjacent but meaningfully earlier Forgot Password control.
Normal sequential form progression from Username input to Password input; useful contrast against the only confirmed misordered transition.
Normal continuation within the same form group from Password input to Remember me checkbox.
Implemented order proceeds from Remember me checkbox to Log In button before reaching the misplaced Forgot Password control.
After the misplaced Forgot Password control, focus resumes to the footer link in forward order; useful to show the anomaly is localized to the preceding transition.

subject_summary: No FP or FN transitions are present in the supplied evaluated_transitions for pubmatic. The only reported LNF is also the only ground-truth LNF, so there are no detector errors to analyze. Evidence instead shows a single localized misordering near the end of the login form: implemented focus order places the Log In button before the Forgot Password control, while the inferred meaningful order places Forgot Password earlier.
